RAM stands for Random Access Memory. It is a type of computer memory that can be accessed randomly; that is, any memory can be directly accessed by the processor. RAM is volatile, meaning that it loses its data when the power is turned off, unlike storage devices like hard disk drives or SSDs.

RAM is used to store data that the CPU needs quick access to, such as the operating system, currently open applications, and running processes. The more RAM a computer has, the more it can handle at once, which can make multitasking and running resource-intensive applications smoother.

A laptop is a portable personal computer with a clamshell form factor, combining the display and keyboard into a single device. Laptops are versatile, offering convenience and flexibility for work, study, and entertainment. They feature reduced size and weight, making them ideal for on-the-go use. With advancements in technology, modern laptops boast powerful processors, high-resolution screens, and long battery life, enhancing productivity and multimedia experiences. Their compact design integrates essential components like storage, memory, and connectivity options, making them indispensable in today’s digital world.
write an essay on the topic Social media addiction in around 111 words and also generate the pdf for the same

Social media addiction is a growing concern in the digital age, characterized by excessive use of social media platforms. It leads to neglect of personal responsibilities and social interactions. Addicts often experience anxiety and depression when deprived of access. The constant need for validation through likes and comments can harm mental health. To combat this, users should set limits on screen time, engage in offline activities, and seek support from friends and professionals. Recognizing the signs of addiction and taking proactive steps can help individuals regain control over their digital lives.
